title: I Posted the Laundry-Card Photo After They Ran Cycles on My Balance

parts.text: I checked card 19 at 9:28 p.m. and three dryers I did not start had eaten my balance. Super Vic said cards were communal. I was thirty-seven, tenant, holding a load I had not dried. I photographed the card history, the three dryers, and Vic's name on the last cycle. Then I posted the photo on the laundry board Vic moderated. Management refunded 19 and issued unique PINs. Vic runs his own card. The room finally looks like a balance, not a tip jar. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: Three dryers ran on my laundry-card balance — Part 1/1
social.description: Card history, a super's name, a board they moderated. Has a laundry room ever billed only you?
